frames.headline: Faster coding. A balanced system?
frames.body: A local speedup does not, by itself, rebalance the path to a dependable result.

frames.headline: Delivery has more than one step.
frames.body: Code generation sits inside a larger chain.

frames.headline: Admit everything. Grow the queue.
frames.body: Suppose generation rises from 8 to 100 comparable changes a week. Review and integration stay at 8; every change is admitted.
frames.credit: Hypothetical fixed-capacity model - not study results

frames.headline: Control intake. Keep the constraint.
frames.body: Admit only what downstream stages can finish. The queue need not grow; delivery still tops out at eight.

frames.kicker: The model is not your diagnosis
frames.headline: Find the bottleneck in your system.
points: What consumes review and recovery time?
Can people explain and operate the result?

frames.kicker: Tools and learning can raise capacity
frames.headline: A new equilibrium has to be demonstrated.
frames.body: Treat a redesign as a hypothesis. Test it against a real baseline.

frames.headline: What actually improved end to end?
frames.body: Show what changed beyond the accelerated step.
